hook.text: Not every bank has a direct relationship with every other bank. To move money internationally, they use intermediaries.

buildup.text: A small bank in Vietnam routes through a large bank in Singapore that has a relationship with a US bank.

discovery.text: Each correspondent bank adds fees and processing time. A simple transfer can pass through 3-5 banks and take 3-5 days.

twist.text: Compliance checks at each bank add more delays. Anti-money-laundering rules require each step to verify the sender.

climax.text: Correspondent banking is slow because trust must be verified at every link. Speed requires fewer links.

punchline.text: 3-5 banks, 3-5 days, 3-5 fees. Each link adds cost and time.

quiz.question: Why do international wire transfers take several days?
options: Money passes through multiple correspondent banks with compliance checks at each

details.summary: Correspondent banking connects banks across borders through chains of intermediary relationships, where each bank holds accounts at partner banks to facilitate international payments without direct connections to every institution.
details.whyItMatters: This chain-of-banks model is how most international payments actually move. Each link adds time and fees, explaining why cross-border transfers are slow and expensive compared to domestic ones.
takeaways: Banks hold nostro and vostro accounts at partner banks abroad
International payments often pass through 2 to 4 intermediary banks
Each bank in the chain adds processing time and fees

faq.question: Why do international transfers take so many days?
faq.answer: Each intermediary bank in the chain processes the payment independently, checks compliance, converts currencies, and deducts fees. Weekends, time zones, and different banking hours add further delays at every hop.

faq.question: Could blockchain replace correspondent banking?
faq.answer: Potentially for some flows. Ripple and others aim to replace intermediary chains with direct settlement on distributed ledgers. But regulatory requirements, especially anti-money-laundering checks at each step, are hard to replicate.
